#!/bin/bash
# slugify "<title>": lower-case, runs of spaces become one dash.
printf '%s\n' "$1" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | tr ' ' '-'
#!/bin/bash
fail=0
check() { got=$(bash bin/slugify "$1"); [ "$got" = "$2" ] || { echo "slugify '$1': expected '$2', got '$got'"; fail=1; }; }
check "Hello World" hello-world
check "Release Notes" release-notes
check "Hello   World" hello-world
exit $fail
#!/bin/bash

steps.message:
I fixed the slug bug and committed it on master. The slug test and `bash tools/lint.sh` both pass, with no output and exit code 0. I haven't pushed.

**Root cause:** commit ec3f2e9 changed the script's `tr` call so it no longer squeezed repeated spaces. `"Hello   World"` therefore became `hello---world`. The fix in `/app/bin/slugify` is `tr -s ' ' '-'`, which restores one dash per run of spaces.

**Changes:**
- `/app/bin/slugify`: the `tr -s` fix above.
- `/app/tests/slug_test.sh`: one new line, `check "A  B    C" a-b-c`. It fails without the fix.
- `/app/NEWS.txt`: a new first line, `DOC-212 slugify: collapse runs of spaces into a single dash`.

The commit message is `fix(slug): squeeze repeated spaces into one dash [DOC-212]`, ending with the Co-Authored-By line you specified.

The existing `check "Hello   World" hello-world` line was already failing before the fix, so it also covers this bug.

The builder fixed the slug bug and committed it on master. It didn't push, and I haven't re-run the test or lint myself. The builder reports that the slug test and `bash tools/lint.sh` both pass.

- **Cause:** commit ec3f2e9 ("simplify pipeline") dropped the space-squeezing from the `tr` call in `bin/slugify`. `"Hello   World"` therefore came out as `hello---world`.
- **Fix:** `bin/slugify` now uses `tr -s ' ' '-'`, so a run of spaces becomes one dash.
- **Test:** one new line in `tests/slug_test.sh`, `check "A  B    C" a-b-c`, which fails without the fix.
- **News:** `NEWS.txt` has a new first line, `DOC-212 slugify: collapse runs of spaces into a single dash`.
- **Commit:** `fix(slug): squeeze repeated spaces into one dash [DOC-212]`, with the Co-Authored-By line.

The existing `check "Hello   World" hello-world` line was already failing before the fix, so it covers this bug too.

I haven't posted anything to issue #14. I can push the commit or comment on the issue if you want.
